# Blog Strategy Plan (Auto-Generated)

> Generated by `scripts/generate_blog_strategy.py` from 32 local blog skill sources. Rerun to overwrite.

## Executive Summary

<!-- SUMMARY -->
A six-pillar program covering the full lifecycle: evidence-first research, persona-driven creation, dual-surface optimization (Google + AI citations), cluster-based internal linking, multilingual expansion, and continuous decay control. Every stage maps to an installed skill, making execution repeatable and auditable.

## Topic Pillars

- **Content Creation Engine** — Own the brief-to-publish pipeline with persona-driven drafting and rich media so every post ships fast without sacrificing voice.
  - Source skills: blog-brief, blog-outline, blog-write, blog-persona, blog-style, blog-brand, blog-chart, blog-image, blog-audio (9)
- **Research & Evidence** — Ground every claim in verifiable sources to maximize E-E-A-T and AI-citation readiness.
  - Source skills: blog-discourse, blog-factcheck, blog-notebooklm (3)
- **Search & AI Citation Optimization** — Win both classic Google rankings and LLM citations (ChatGPT, Perplexity, AI Overviews) via schema, structured answers, and Google field data.
  - Source skills: blog-seo-check, blog-schema, blog-geo, blog-google, blog-flow (5)
- **Planning, Distribution & Repurposing** — Cluster-led architecture plus systematic repurposing turns one article into ten distribution assets.
  - Source skills: blog-strategy, blog-cluster, blog-calendar, blog-repurpose (4)
- **Global Reach (i18n)** — Multiply addressable audience with SEO-safe translation, cultural localization, and hreflang hygiene.
  - Source skills: blog-translate, blog-localize, blog-multilingual, blog-locale-audit, blog-taxonomy (5)
- **Quality, Measurement & Decay Control** — Audit, score, and refresh continuously so traffic compounds instead of decaying.
  - Source skills: blog-analyze, blog-audit, blog-decay, blog-cannibalization, blog-rewrite (5)

## Publishing Cadence

| Slot | Volume | Output |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Flagship posts | 1 per week | New cluster article (brief -> outline -> write -> factcheck -> seo-check) |
| Secondary posts | 1 per week | Supporting spoke article or refreshed rewrite |
| Refresh slot | 1 per month | Decay-flagged post updated via blog-decay + blog-rewrite |

Total: 2 posts per week sustained; every 6th week one slot is reserved for audit-driven consolidation.

## Distribution Channels

- Email newsletter (weekly digest of new posts)
- LinkedIn articles + posts (B2B reach)
- X/Twitter threads via blog-repurpose
- Reddit practitioner communities via blog-discourse insights
- YouTube Shorts / podcast audio via blog-audio
- Internal linking mesh from hub pillar pages

## Success Metrics

- Organic sessions: +20% quarter over quarter (Search Console)
- AI citation rate: brand cited in >=5 tracked LLM answers per month
- Cluster coverage: 100% of pillars have >=1 published cluster
- Average content score >=85/100 on blog-analyze before publish
- Decay alerts resolved within 2 weeks (0 stale >180 days)
- Repurpose ratio: >=4 derivative assets per flagship post

## Governance

- Validation gates: generator fails non-zero on missing sections, so an invalid plan can never be committed.
- Quarterly: rerun blog-audit + locale-audit; reconcile this plan against actuals in Success Metrics.
